description: Returns the leader schedule for an epoch.

parameters.name: u64
parameters.description: Fetchs the leader schedule for the epoch that corresponds to the provided slot. If unspecified, the leader schedule for the current epoch is fetched

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: identity
sub_parameters.description: Only returns the results for this validator identity encoded as base-58

result.description: Null if the requested epoch is not found otherwise the result field will be a dictionary of validator identities, as base-58 encoded strings, and their corresponding leader slot indices as values (indices are relative to the first slot in the requested epoch)
